summary: Linear progress bar on the native progress element, determinate or indeterminate.

usage.text: Set value="" for indeterminate. With no value attribute it shows 0, the default, and a value that is not a number is treated as 0.
The value is clamped to 0 through max. While determinate, a rounded percentage is shown beside the label.

a11y.text: The label attribute is shown and names the bar; without it the name is "Progress". The value-text attribute sets aria-valuetext.
